name: ModelVariant759_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant759_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (the ambient light dims while an animated glow plays under the slot, two pairs of tilted colour waves fade out, an animated flash flickers and a ring of expanding strips swells towards the other slot, then the glow and waves play again and the light comes back); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request, builds the glow, wave and flash quads, packs three texture images and shapes the strip rings from the other slot's dimensions, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 before the start, 1 while each glow holds, 0 between and after them and 2 at the end; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-776 and 873 images build it from the same source. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
